title: Create voice memo storage adapter
description: Implement IndexedDB storage for audio recordings with browser-based persistence
tasks: Implement IndexedDB schema for audio blobs
Handle recording Blob to URL conversion
Add error handling for storage quota exceeded
Add cleanup function for expired memos
acceptanceCriteria: Audio blobs are stored with unique IDs
saveVoiceMemo returns memo URL with metadata
getVoiceMemo retrieves audio blob by ID
listVoiceMemos returns array of stored memos
Storage quota errors are caught and handled gracefully
Expired memos (> 30 days) are cleaned up
